description: Issue #44 (CommandMate #1678 B-2): an issue naming web/package.json gets that directory's lockfiles allowed by default — they join suspected_files (the worker's future scope.allow) and the plan says so in scope_defaults, so `npm install` rewriting the lockfile is no longer a scope violation the worker cannot resolve. Since Issue #147 the same list also carries `web/main.ts`'s conventional test paths: both default sources share one exit, so nothing can reach scope.allow without also being reported in scope_defaults.
